# The Cooperative Agency: full site text

> The Cooperative Agency, based in Baton Rouge, serves Louisiana and the surrounding area and runs the whole marketing and sales engine for car dealerships and other businesses: strategy, content, social, reporting, systems, AI and custom apps. We act as an outsourced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and Marketing Director, so clients have fewer, smarter partners instead of more vendors.

Backed by two decades of hands-on dealership marketing, sales and systems experience, we blend creative horsepower with operational strategy: streamlining vendors, maximizing manufacturer co-op, and fixing the cracks where leads and dollars get lost. Automotive is our deepest specialty, and the same systems-driven approach serves small businesses, startups and restaurants.

## What we do

- **Outsourced CTO and Marketing Director:** We manage the entire marketing and sales tech stack, aligning creative, tools and tactics with business goals, not vendor agendas.
- **PostEngine (our own social publishing software):** We built PostEngine in-house to run social media for every client; it replaced the third-party scheduler we used before. Posting rules by department (for dealers: new cars, service, parts) put the right content on Instagram, Facebook and Google Business on the right days, timed to promotions, seasons and the local market. Every post is reviewed before it publishes.
- **GM Weekly:** A custom weekly report we build, run and maintain for each store, pulling traffic, inventory, leads, response times and close rates into one page with real dates. We then sit down with the general manager and turn it into next steps: which leads are slipping, which sources aren't closing, where the team needs help.
- **AI systems and custom apps:** More and more of our work runs through AI and apps we build ourselves, from publishing and reporting tools to lead handling and website chat.
- **Optimize spend and maximize co-op:** We identify waste, clean up lead flow and manage co-op claims, with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) compliance in mind.
- **Custom photo, video and drone content:** Original content of the real business, local settings, real staff, real inventory. No stock images. Drone work is included.
- **Brand consistency across channels:** Content deployed across Google Business, websites, paid ads, email and social.
- **Vendor management:** We eliminate overlapping services and become the single point of contact for marketing operations.
- **Lead and CRM fixes:** We diagnose and fix lead flow, customer relationship management (CRM) setup and follow-up processes.
- **Fast turnaround:** Creative is built in-house and can deploy within hours for sales events, incentives and urgent updates.

## Who we work with

- Car dealerships, from single rooftops to multi-location groups, across Louisiana and the surrounding area, with boots-on-the-ground content creation.
- Other businesses: small business startups (website and brand consulting, go-to-market strategy, systems setup), restaurants (websites, menu content, photography, social media) and other verticals.

Most dealers pay a separate vendor for a dashboard, then nobody has time to make sense of it. # FAQ — The Cooperative Agency

URL: https://thecoopbrla.com/faq

## Frequently asked questions.
### What does The Cooperative Agency do?
We’re a full-service marketing and sales systems consultancy specializing in automotive dealerships. From outsourced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and Marketing Director services to custom content creation, vendor coordination, and co-op management — we help you streamline operations and drive more sales, all for less than the cost of a single full-time employee.
### How is The Cooperative different from traditional automotive marketing agencies?
Most agencies are bloated, slow, and rely on templated, cookie-cutter content. We’re fast, local, and laser-focused on custom content that actually connects with your customers. You’ll never get generic stock photos or recycled ad copy from us. We build everything from scratch — tailored to your brand, your team, and your market.
### Can you help with manufacturer co-op claims?
Yes — every service we provide is structured to maximize co-op eligibility. We tailor your strategy, creative, and deployment with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) compliance in mind and even help submit your claims. You keep your brand voice and get reimbursed.
### What’s your turnaround time on campaigns and creative?
Fast. While traditional agencies can take weeks, we deploy within hours when needed — especially for sales events, incentives, and urgent updates. Our creative is built and managed in-house so there’s no middleman delay.
### Do you manage social media for dealerships?
Absolutely. We handle everything — including:
- Local photo and video shoots
- Reels and short-form video content
- Strategic scheduling around promotions
- OEM-aligned messaging
- Consistent multi-platform branding
We ensure your social channels stay engaging, on-brand, and up to date.
### What kind of content do you produce?
We produce everything from:
- Localized photography and video
- Reels and walkarounds
- OEM-compliant graphics
- Google Business updates
- Website creative
- Ad platform assets
All of it customized to your dealership, your community, and your goals.
### Can you help fix lead and CRM issues?
Yes. We’re not just marketers — we’re systems people. We diagnose and resolve issues with lead flow, customer relationship management (CRM) setup, follow-up processes, and more. No more leads slipping through the cracks.
### Can you manage all our vendors?
That’s one of our specialties. We simplify the chaos by becoming your single point of contact. We coordinate with all vendors, eliminate redundancies, and streamline communications so your systems actually work together.
### Are your services eligible for co-op reimbursement?
### Where do you provide services?
We work with dealerships in the southern region from Baton Rouge, Louisiana, but we pride ourselves on keeping it local. That means boots-on-the-ground content creation, regionalized strategies, and service that’s fast, familiar, and flexible.
### What types of dealers do you work with?
### Do you only work with automotive dealerships?
While the automotive space is our specialty, we absolutely work with other industries as well. Our systems-driven approach to content, marketing, and vendor management applies just as powerfully to other verticals.
We’re currently expanding our services to support:
- Small business startups — website and brand consulting, go-to-market strategy, and systems setup
- Restaurants — website builds, menu content, photography, and full-platform social media management
We’re excited to bring the same level of creativity and operational clarity to these growing segments. More info is coming soon — stay tuned or reach out if you’d like early access.
Ready to talk?
Fill out the client application or chat with us — we’ll meet you where you are.

# Careers — The Cooperative Agency

URL: https://thecoopbrla.com/careers.html

Now hiring · Louisiana
## Join a team that actually moves the needle.
We run the marketing and sales engine for car dealerships and many other verticals as well.
- Inventory photography
- Social that ships
- Video + drone
- Email + web
- Paid + systems
- AI + apps
### The work
You start with inventory photography and social media content for our dealerships. Cars on the lot, shot well, posted fast. It's real volume with a real bar, and it teaches you how the whole machine runs.
We're a small team, and small teams don't do lanes. If you can write, design, cut video, build email, or think in systems, there's more waiting: magazines, websites, paid campaigns, other brands entirely. More and more of our work runs through AI and the apps we build ourselves. You should want in on that. You won't get all of it day one. You'll get as much as you can carry.
### Who we want
Someone inspired, hardworking, and a little entrepreneurial.
- You're willing to shoot inventory photography.
- You're very good at social media content.
- You have a body of work to show. Self-taught is fine. Your feed is your résumé.
- The AI and app side of what we do excites you.
We'll hand you real responsibility, not meeting notes and coffee runs. You must be 21 or older. Living in or near Baton Rouge, Louisiana is a plus, but your work matters more than your résumé.
### How to apply
Fill out the form below. It takes a few minutes. Show us your work: a portfolio website, your social media, or both.
Rather talk first? Call (225) 240-4570 or tap the chat button on this page. You can also email lance@thecoopbrla.com.
### Know a creator?
Know a creator who should see this? Send them this page, or email lance@thecoopbrla.com with the subject "creator referral."
### Faculty and advisors
Faculty and advisors: happy to send a Handshake brief or do a 15-minute class visit — lance@thecoopbrla.com.
— Lance Faucheux, co-founder
